name: Eyestrike
description: Targeted creature's eyes become dull white blinding them for 1 round and dealing 1d4 damage.

name: Mind Blast
description: Projecting a mental wave you deal 1d4 damage to a target and push them away close distance.

name: Psychic Backlash
description: Your mental abilities disrupt normal spellcasting, the first time an enemy creature casts a spell within near it gains disadvantage.

name: Psychic Shockwave
description: Amplifying the target creature's mental state you cause 1d4 damage to all creatures within close of the target.

name: Psychovampiric Touch
description: Focusing your mental abilities you reach out dealing 1d4 damage and gaining the damage dealt as weapon damage for 5 rounds.

name: Whisper of Treason
description: Your words fill a target creatures mind causing it attack an ally on its next turn.

name: Amplified Thrust
description: A focused wave of mental energy strikes a target creature for 1d6 damage, a secondary creature within half near of the target takes 1d12 damage.

name: Mental Binding
description: A mental stasis is put in place, all enemy creaures within near that are LVL 3 and below are paralyzed for the spell's duration.

name: Mind Blades
description: You project a psionic blade that jumps from target to target, up to 5 times, dealing 1d4 damage.

name: Psychovampiric Shield
description: Focusing your mental abilities you reach out dealing 1d6 damage and gaining the damage dealt as AC for the spell's duration.

name: Recall Agony
description: You make a creature relive its most recent trauma, for the spell's duration if that creature is damage they take an additional 1d6.

name: Reveal Secrets
description: You pry into the mind of a target creature, DC12 CHA save or have a secret revealed. A successful save reveals your intentions.

name: Fractured Violition
description: Tricking the target creature into believing they're weak you reduce all their physical damage by 50% for the spell's duration.

name: Pain Link
description: Syncing mental waves with a creature, all damage dealt is split in half and applied to the both of you for the spell's duration.

name: Psychovampiric Leech
description: Focusing your mental abilities you reach out dealing 1d8 point of damage and gaining the damage dealt as CHR for the spell's duration.

name: Puppet Master
description: Breaking the mental fortitude of a target creature you're able to control them for the spell's duration. Simplistic commands only.

name: Remove Memory
description: You pry into the mind of a target creature, DC13 CHA save or have a memory forgotten. A successful save reveals your intentions.

name: Soul Ignition
description: You cause an overbearing mental strain on a target creature, they take 3d4 damage then 3d4 damage each round for the spell's duration.

name: Mind Lance
description: Focusing your will on a single devistating attack you deal 3d8 damage to a target creature.

name: Pain Block
description: You reach into a creature's mind and dulling their pain receptors, target gains resistance to all damage for the spell's duration.

name: Reaping Armament
description: Through force of will alone you focus mental energy into the shape of a +3 magical weapon you're proficient with.

name: Silent Scream
description: You cause the target creature to suffer a mental breakdown, they take 2d8 damage and are silenced for 1 round.

name: Telekinesis
description: You're able to lift a creature or object that weighs 1,000lbs or less with your mind. You can move it a near distance in any direction and hold it in place.

name: Tactical Meld
description: You project a clear plan of attack to your allies, all weapon attacks have advantage against your target for spell's duration.

name: Amplified Wave
description: Amplifying your ally's mental state, you cause 2d12 damage to any enemy creature within double close of the target.

name: Brain Hemorrhage
description: Overloading a target creature's mind with psychic energy you deal 3d8 damage, if the target is LVL 5 or lower it instantly dies.

name: Defensive Mind-Web
description: Melding the minds of all allies within near, mind-affecting spells or abilities that allow a save get a group roll. Take the highest.

name: Go Between
description: You focus your mental energies on a target creature, DC15 CHA save or you swap bodies. A successful save reveals your intentions.

name: Mind Plague
description: You create a psionic plague that jumps from target to target, up to 3 times, imposing disadvantage on all checks for the spell's duration.

name: Time Parasite
description: You sap the mental energy from a target creature, for the spell's duration they are slowed and you are hasted.
